notifications.no_notifications_desc: When you get news, stamps or messages from the community, you will see them here.
company.rooms.new.early_access_desc: Set a future release date and UNLOCKED Premium subscribers will see this room up to 3 days before it goes public.
company.rooms.edit.early_access_desc: Set a future release date and UNLOCKED Premium subscribers will see this room up to 3 days before it goes public.
company.settings.ea_description: When you add a new room, UNLOCKED Premium subscribers will be able to discover it 3 days before it goes live to the public. This gives your rooms a head start with the most engaged players on the platform.
company.settings.perk1: See new rooms 3 days before public release
fer.hero_subtitle: The platform that brings players to your escape room. Showcase your rooms, send players to your own site to book, and keep them coming back with stamps, the community and merch.
fer.features_subtitle: From showcasing your rooms to stamps and merch, you get every tool to reach more players.
fer.feat_analytics_desc: See how many players tap "Book on Their Site" for each room and day, and how many took a stamp.
fer.feat_booknow_desc: Each room's booking button sends players straight to your own site or booking system. No middleman.
fer.feat_passport_desc: Show the QR at the end of the game and every player gets your room's stamp in their passport. Stamps open floors in the Haunted Tower, so they bring players back.
fer.feat_community_desc: Players share their escapes, photos and your rooms in the UNLOCKED community, and bring their friends.
fer.feat_merch_desc: Sell t-shirts, mugs and souvenirs of your rooms. Payments go straight to your own account.
fer.how_step1_desc: Register your company on business.unlocked.gr. It takes less than 2 minutes.
fer.how_step2_desc: Set up your rooms with descriptions, photos, difficulty levels and the booking link of your own site.
fer.how_step3_desc: At the end of every game, show the UNLOCKED QR: each player gets your room's stamp in their passport.
fer.how_step4_desc: See how many players head to your site, sell merch and reach new players through the community.
fer.faq1_a: For packages and prices, contact us and we will tell you what suits your escape room.
fer.faq2_q: How do players book my rooms?
fer.faq2_a: On each room's page, players tap "Book on Their Site" and go to the booking link you set: your own website or booking system. If you have none, your phone number is shown instead.
fer.faq3_q: Can I keep my own booking system?
fer.faq3_a: Of course. UNLOCKED does not take bookings or payments for rooms: it sends players to your own site, where they book and pay as always.
fer.faq4_a: At the end of every game you show a QR from your company dashboard. Each player scans it and gets your room's stamp in their passport, which opens floors and gifts in the Haunted Tower game. So players want to come back for more rooms.
fer.faq5_a: After you register, our team reviews your application. This usually takes 1-2 working days. You will get an email as soon as you are approved.
fer.faq6_a: Yes. From your company dashboard you add products to the UNLOCKED shop. Payments go straight to your own Stripe or Viva account, and you handle pickup or shipping.
fer.faq7_a: Yes! We offer professional website development from €500. Our sites are built for escape rooms: fast, mobile-friendly, SEO-optimized and linked with UNLOCKED.
fer.faq8_a: Every partner gets email support at hello@unlocked.gr.
fer.cta_subtitle: Join UNLOCKED today and start reaching more players, giving out stamps and building a community around your rooms.
dir.seo_p1: UNLOCKED is the escape room community. Whether you are planning a trip abroad or looking for the best adventure in your city, our directory helps you compare themes, see photos and book straight on each room's own website.
dir.tip_1: Book early on the room's website: popular rooms fill up fast, especially at weekends.
dir.book_step2_desc: Tap "Book on Their Site" and pick your time directly on the escape room's website.
dir.faq4_a: Yes, booking ahead is strongly recommended in {city}. Popular rooms and weekend times fill up fast. Book on the escape room's own website.
cx.pp.title: End of game
cx.pp.subtitle: Show the QR to the team: each player scans it and gets the room's stamp in their UNLOCKED passport.
cx.pp.start_time_bad: Pick the time the team's game started.
cx.pp.rules: The QR works for 30 minutes and gives as many stamps as there are players. Each player gets one stamp per room.
cx.website.label: Your website
cx.website.hint: Players press "Book now" on UNLOCKED and land here to book.

cx.ig.title: Instagram on your room pages
cx.ig.desc: Show your 9 latest Instagram posts on your room pages, linked to Instagram. Your account must be public. We refresh them once a day.
cx.ig.saved_syncing: Saved. Your posts will appear in a minute.
cx.ig.err.not_found: We couldn't find that account, or it is private.
cx.ig.err.fetch_failed: We couldn't reach Instagram. We will try again tomorrow.
cx.video_url.label: Trailer video (optional)
cx.video_url.hint: A YouTube or Vimeo link. It is shown on the room page.
cx.clicks.title: Players sent to your site
cx.clicks.desc: "Book on Their Site" clicks in the last 30 days
cx.clicks.no_site: Add your website in Settings so "Book now" takes players there.
cx.onboarding.confirm_text: Tap "Continue" and our team will review your application. We will get in touch about packages and prices.
cx.pay.subtitle_merch: Connect your Stripe or Viva account so players can pay for your merch online. The money goes straight into your own account.
cx.pay.not_connected_merch: No account connected. Until you connect one, players pay for merch at pickup.
cx.pay.disconnect_warning_merch: After disconnecting, players can only pay for merch at pickup. Orders already paid stay paid. Enter your password to confirm.
cx.pay.how_1_merch: Players order your merch and pay on a secure Stripe or Viva page.
premium.perk.early_rooms_desc: See new rooms up to 3 days before everyone else.
